status: Exploratory revision analysis, specified before calculating the additional scores; not a preregistered study
classification: Caravan catchment-majority HydroATLAS GEnS climate zones (clz_cl_smj); include all official zone labels containing temperate; verify official legend before evaluating scores
partition: Intersect the original donor/calibration/test index sets with climate membership, never resplit according to outcomes
ablation: Reshape monthly quantiles to n x 12 x 32; subtract each monthly quantile mean to obtain centered shape. Mean squared full distance equals location distance plus shape distance, to numerical precision. Quantile-location is a quadrature approximation to mean transformed flow, not raw monthly mean flow.
predictor: Per-attribute median of donor records; exclude target physical station; preserve original record-based donor convention
scaling: Attribute IQR and distance medians computed from the actual donor subset only. Also report fixed original-donor-IQR scores for comparisons across donor designs.

bootstrap.interpretation: individual exploratory intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted or spatial-block intervals

reporting: All nine methods and all contrasts against monthly, including null or adverse results
subgroups: lower and higher snow fraction using the donor median, with ties assigned to lower
subgroup_rule: Use already selected predictions and weights; no subgroup-specific tuning; report sample counts and raw attribute errors
falsification: Do not infer climate-specific differences merely from differing interval significance, and do not infer causal hydrological mechanisms from attribute-transfer gains
